name: @companion/atlas-server
description: Companion Atlas — containerized 3D processing server + MCP API that turns geodata, images, and video into shareable 4D scrapbook stories.

comments.note: Heavy native reconstruction tools (COLMAP, OpenDroneMap/NodeODM, Nerfstudio, ffmpeg) are NOT npm dependencies. They run in the GPU worker container (docker/Dockerfile.worker) and are invoked by src/pipeline.ts over a job queue. This package only orchestrates them.
